decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to maximize devotion to green in order to ramp up mana quickly and play big creatures like Voracious Hydra and Old-Growth Troll. The deck includes cards like Storm the Festival to search for more creatures, and Oath of Nissa to help with card selection. The inclusion of cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional utility and protection for the key green creatures. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful green creatures and aggressive plays.

This deck focuses on aggressive early game plays and disruption to control the game, exploiting the graveyard and dealing damage quickly. With a mix of powerful creatures and removal spells, the goal is to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan. The mana base is set up to support the aggressive strategy, allowing for consistent casting of spells. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creatures and removal spells to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by countering opponent's spells, removing threats, and drawing cards to outvalue the opponent. By utilizing a combination of counterspells, board wipes, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, the deck aims to stall the game until it can establish a win condition like Shark Typhoon or Dream Trawler. The mana base is designed to provide consistency in casting spells while also providing some utility lands for extra value. The overall strategy is to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantage.

Utilizing a green devotion strategy, this Pioneer deck focuses on aggressive play and ramping up mana quickly. With cards like Polukranos, World Eater and Voracious Hydra, as well as powerful mana producers like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with large creatures early in the game. Further support is provided by cards like Wolfwillow Haven and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, enabling explosive plays and high devotion counts to maximize the deck's potential power.

This deck focuses on sacrificing creatures for value, with Cauldron Familiar and Korvold, Fae-Cursed King being key pieces. By repeatedly sacrificing creatures using Witch's Oven and Deadly Dispute, players can deal damage and draw cards with Mayhem Devil on the battlefield. Claim the Firstborn can steal opponent's creatures to sacrifice them for additional value. The deck also includes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push. The mana base is designed to support the deck's three-color combination of black, red, and green.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and powerful removal spells to apply pressure to the opponent. By combining cards like Bonecrusher Giant, Graveyard Trespasser, and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger with efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a threatening board presence. Additionally, cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Chandra, Torch of Defiance provide card advantage and additional reach to close out games quickly. The deck also utilizes a variety of lands to ensure consistent mana access and flexibility in casting spells.

The main focus of this deck is to consistently generate value through sacrificing creatures and artifacts to trigger various effects, such as dealing damage to the opponent or gaining life. By using cards like Witch's Oven and Mayhem Devil, the deck aims to control the board while slowly chipping away at the opponent's life total. The inclusion of cards like The Meathook Massacre and Shrapnel Blast provide additional reach and the ability to close out games quickly. Overall, the deck revolves around sacrificing and utilizing resources efficiently to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful threats like Torrential Gearhulk and Magma Opus. The key idea is to create a disruptive game plan by combining these big threats with counter magic like Mystical Dispute and Prismari Command. The deck also includes card draw and filtering with Dig Through Time and Consider to help find key combo pieces. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements while providing flexibility in casting spells.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana through green devotion creatures and enchantments like Wolfwillow Haven and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, while overwhelming the opponent with aggressive threats like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. Utilizing cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival, this deck aims to establish board presence early on and maintain pressure throughout the game, eventually overpowering the opponent with large creatures and strong synergy between devotion creatures and enchantments.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. It combines card draw spells like Opt and Consider with cheap removal spells like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse to control the board while building towards casting multiple spells in a turn to bring back the Phoenix. Cards like Thing in the Ice and Galvanic Iteration provide additional threats and options for recurring spells. The deck aims to be fast and aggressive, overwhelming opponents with a flurry of spells and creatures.

The main goal of this deck is to assemble the Lotus Field combo as quickly as possible to generate a large amount of mana. This is achieved by using cards like Arboreal Grazer, Sylvan Scrying, and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to find and play Lotus Field. Once Lotus Field is in play, the deck aims to cast big spells like Dig Through Time, Emergent Ultimatum, and Omniscience to overwhelm the opponent and win the game. The deck also includes cards like Hidden Strings and Galvanic Iteration to generate additional value and disruption.

The key concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to deliver swift, aggressive damage to the opponent while also disrupting their game plan with hand disruption and removal spells. The deck focuses on a combination of powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Gifted Aetherborn alongside efficient removal spells such as Fatal Push and Infernal Grasp. Thoughtseize and Invoke Despair add a layer of disruption by allowing the player to strip key cards from their opponent's hand. By applying pressure early and disrupting the opponent's strategy, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm and defeat the opponent.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing powerful creatures like Kroxa and Nicol Bolas to quickly overwhelm opponents. The inclusion of cards like Fatal Push, Dreadbore, and Thoughtseize allows for disruption of the opponent's strategy while maintaining pressure. The deck also benefits from a unique companion card, Jegantha, the Wellspring, providing additional flexibility and advantages in gameplay. By efficiently deploying creatures and removal spells, this deck aims to outpace opponents and secure victory through a combination of aggression and control.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm your opponent with fast and aggressive red creatures and burn spells, taking advantage of cards like Hazoret the Fervent and Torbran, Thane of Red Fell. By constantly applying pressure with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Chainwhirler, while using burn spells like Play with Fire and Spikefield Hazard to control the board and finish off your opponent, this deck aims to win quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel and Rampaging Ferocidon further punish opponents for playing spells and gain incremental advantages throughout the game.

The main idea of the deck is to control the game by countering opponent's spells, removing threats, and generating card advantage. It aims to stall the game until it can stabilize and then win through powerful finishers like Emrakul, the Promised End and Shark Typhoon. The deck also utilizes planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils to generate additional value. Overall, the deck focuses on disruption, control, and card advantage to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a long game.
